items.title: 'A new Plaza Accord?' Japan's battle against yen bears enters new phase
Why Le Pen's plan for a constitutional referendum would be 'a coup d'état in form and content'
items.description: If she were to win, far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen has pledged to call a referendum to revise the Constitution and enshrine the far right's core principles in it. According to a member of the highest administrative court, this would be 'a double coup d'état, both in form and content.'

items.title: With war slowing Saudi food imports, hydroponics provide a homegrown solution
items.description: Hydroponic farms in import-reliant Saudi Arabia are good for business – and for national security as well. With the arid kingdom facing blockades and disruptions on both its coasts, growing food in water, surprisingly, is providing a green line of defense.
